superseded_guards.guard: V2 raw checkout Prompt identity assertions

accepted_repairs.protected_invariant: Frozen source identity is independent of LF or CRLF checkout bytes and mapping validation writes only to pytest-owned temporary paths.
Prompt.txt is nonauthoritative workflow metadata and cannot determine scientific, governance, or historical-evidence validity.
The selected historical report is generated deterministically in a pytest-owned temporary directory while its ignored live path remains absent.
Retention-expired report existence is retired as a current aggregate requirement while identity-local semantic controls remain independently routed.
Eight tracked route sources use frozen Git-blob identities and one generated review uses canonical-artifact identity while historical raw pins remain unchanged.
Current executable compendium bindings use the frozen Git blob while all historical mixed-EOL pins and compendium content remain unchanged.
Historical source, generator, and review-time authority identities remain immutable and are validated separately from current successors.
The accepted recovery base contains every earlier accepted implementation and preserves its protected invariants.
Current maintenance authority is interpreted only by a strict duplicate-key-rejecting parser and the one-use bootstrap authority remains consumed.
Pillar V1 historical review pins remain immutable and are validated separately from commit-relative current Git-blob identities.
Every Pillar V1 staging identity is typed in one dependency-complete table before repair.
Every collected test is assigned to exactly one pre-execution profile and unknown current reachability fails closed.
Historical staging pins and current canonical identities remain role-separated while the original authority-class mismatch stays fail-closed.
Every nonpassing obligation has reviewed current reachability and unknown current reachability is zero.
The current acceptance inventory and execution profiles are frozen before execution, exact-partitioned, and immutable during a run.
Current admissibility and cross-reference controls use stable identities while the superseded broad-EOL snapshot remains visible as historical debt.
